cohort_05_feed_failure_28_feeds.observation: 28/76 feeds failed in cohort 2026-09-23_05. Specifically: all 20 Bithumb trade feeds failed (bithumb/trade/KRW-*) plus all 8 Upbit feeds (4 trade + 4 orderbook). Bithumb orderbook feeds (20x3=60 slots minus 20 trade = 40 orderbook) and Binance feeds (8) appear to have data.
cohort_05_feed_failure_28_feeds.inference: Feed failures are concentrated on Bithumb trade and all Upbit feeds. This suggests a collection gap or finalization failure affecting these specific feed types, not a global conflict counter propagation (which would hit all 76 slots). The pattern differs from v4r1 which showed all 76 slots failing.
cohort_05_feed_failure_28_feeds.v4r1_regression: BITHUMB_CONFLICTING_DUPLICATE regression: CANNOT_CONFIRM_RESOLVED. The v4r1 pattern (all 76 slots fail due to global counter) is not observed here (only 28/76 fail). However, the exact failure_reasons are absent from the receipt.
cohort_05_feed_failure_28_feeds.new_failure_mode: POSSIBLE — 20 Bithumb trade + 8 Upbit feeds failing while Bithumb orderbook and Binance pass is a pattern not seen in v4r1. Requires log analysis to determine root cause.

missing_cohort_receipts.observation: 5 of 6 expected qualifying cohort receipts are absent from S3 archive-receipts/. Only cohort_05 was successfully archived.
missing_cohort_receipts.inference_1: Archive scheduler may have failed after cohort_05, preventing cohorts 06 from being finalized.
missing_cohort_receipts.inference_2: Cohorts 01-04 receipt absence could mean: (a) S3 put failed for earlier cohorts, or (b) archiver was not running until cohort_05. The archiver.last_receipt=null in observability/latest.json contradicts receipt_05 existing in S3 — this suggests the observability snapshot was taken after supervisor shutdown and archiver was not yet aware, OR archiver state was reset.
missing_cohort_receipts.archiver_stale_status: archiver.status=STALE at 09:18 UTC (2.5h after run end) — archiver stopped after supervisor. last_receipt=null in observability but cohort_05 receipt exists in S3. This discrepancy is unexplained without log access.

observability_archiver_discrepancy.observation: observability/latest.json at 09:18 UTC shows archiver.last_receipt=null, archiver.last_s3_put=null, archiver.last_compression=null, archiver.last_closed_cohort=null. Yet cohort_2026-09-23_05_finalized.json exists in S3 with finalized_at_utc=06:10:15Z.
observability_archiver_discrepancy.interpretation: This suggests observability/latest.json was last written after supervisor shutdown with a fresh/reset archiver state snapshot, and the archiver's in-memory state was not persisted. The receipt was written directly to S3 by the archive scheduler at 06:10:15Z before the shutdown. The observability tracker does not retain archiver history across restarts.
